reviews.text: It gets one star for atmosphere and food and two for service. They were busy and we felt it despite our reservation. The food was honestly underwhelming. The eggs Benedict was a gooey mess with runny whites that made me want to vomit. The cinnamon bun was overcooked on the outside and undercooked on the inside. The cappuccino is made with a Columbian bean that tastes like burnt Starbucks and is served with a stupid rock sugar stick instead of a spoon and the milk to espresso ratio was off. The espresso martini as god awful - I’ve had 500 versions of an espresso martini and I’ve never grimaced harder in my life - and it had ice in it. My husband’s burrito was aggressively seasoned and tasted terrible in an unidentifiable way. With a limited menu you would think it would be their expertly executed items. This is the epitome of overpriced due to location. Save yourself a few hundred bucks and go to diner.
reviews.author: Caitlin Nelson

reviews.text: Went here for brunch.  We spent well over $100 for the two of us, no alcohol, and most of our meal was just...meh.  The cinnamon roll was undercooked in the middle and there was so much icing on it the whole thing was just a blob of mush.  My burger, which I ordered well done, was barely medium.  The meat in the burrito was inedible and the burrito was mostly avocado. My water glass was broken across the top.  I expected better from this establishment. The waiter was great and the place is adorable, but it isn't worth the money when there are amazing places within a mile or two of here for half the price. Parking was also another $14.
reviews.author: Sheri Derence

reviews.text: We visited from Georgia and had the pleasure of meeting Raul as our bartender. Raul is used to serving large crowds with people not sure what to order, so he has knowledge of every drink - he can curate something up in moments that’s spectacular. Service was excellent, food was delicious and the overall experience was perfect. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Mary Tritt

reviews.text:
We live in the East Valley (Chandler/Tempe) and it’s always a treat to go to some local favorites. From the moment you arrive at The Phoenician, you walk into an idyllic setting. We tried Mowry & Cotton the other night to celebrate our anniversary and spend time with my mom, sister, and son.

We were immediately greeted by the staff and sat in a comfortable and elegant setting. Our server, Dora, was knowledgeable about the wine and pairings. Her dining assistant, Iris, was prompt, never let our waters deplete, and made sure the table was taken care of. Dora specifically recommended a delicious white, a rosé, and delicious reds to complement our appetizers and dinner.

The food was spot on! The branzino delectable! Red snapper, was fresh, highly recommend! My son’s streak perfectly cooked! Yum!

But for real it was the Service of see Dora!
reviews.author: T S

reviews.text: We had such a wonderful dining experience with Dora as our server and Iris as the dining assistant.  The service,  food, and wine was wonderful.  We are local and love having an enjoyable experiences in our home town as well as traveling.
reviews.author: TravelingTK

reviews.text: So husband and I was here for a weekend getaway. I can honestly say Jordan and Raul were the highlight of my trip. The knowledge they shared about making a fine cocktails. They really love their craft. Btw the drinks were excellent but that's what you get when you make drinks with love. Until next time guys.
reviews.author: Alesha Stanton

reviews.text: Eggs especially the omelette were weirdly fake
reviews.author: James Halstead

reviews.text:
I made a reservation at Mowry & Cotton for a Valentine’s Day dinner, hoping for a memorable evening. The ambiance was beautiful and romantic, and the service initially felt outstanding. Our server was attentive and professional throughout the night.
We ordered the salmon and the lamb. The salmon was good and well prepared. Unfortunately, the lamb was atrocious. It tasted old and unpleasant, which was extremely disappointing, especially for a special occasion. When we brought it to the waiter’s attention, he was courteous and removed it from the bill. He also offered us a complimentary dessert, which we appreciated. However, the dessert was also not good, and we were unable to finish it.
We then ordered two cappuccinos to end the evening, but they arrived cold and were not appetizing.
Overall, the experience was very underwhelming for a Valentine’s dinner. While the ambiance and initial service were positive, the food quality fell far short of expectations. Sadly, we will not be returning.
reviews.author: Seyed Paransun

reviews.text: We ate here 3 times over 5 day conference... Brunch, lunch, and dinner.... menu varies but all have great options. The birds are a problem outside but they try to keep them under control, even going so far as having a hawk with bird handler there to keep the nuisance birds at bay.  Food was great.
reviews.author: Travis Broadwater

reviews.text:
The highlight of my experience here was watching the hawk chase away the birds looking for a bite to eat. That made the mediocre breakfast worth it.

Prices are what you’d expect of a resort restaurant; however, bacon was extremely undercooked and it took nearly 30 minutes for a basic 2-egg breakfast to be delivered. Service was slow. There were extra items on my bill, so I had to find a server to correct the bill before leaving.
reviews.author: Meggie Hoerr

reviews.text:
My husband took me here for my birthday, and we had an absolutely wonderful experience. From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The food was outstanding! I ordered the lamb, and it honestly tasted like how Christmas feels. Everything we had was delicious, and the service was fantastic from start to finish.

The atmosphere struck the perfect balance of an upscale restaurant while still being wonderfully accommodating to our 3-year-old. One of the waiters even surprised her with a coyote plush, which completely made her day. Thank you to everyone at Mowry & Cotton for such a memorable evening. We can’t wait to return!
reviews.author: Sammy Hartwell

reviews.text: Perfect dining experience for my wife's birthday
reviews.author: Paul Hartwell

reviews.text: The front check in girl is weird. She's too zesty. Food and ambience is pretty good. Bit expensive though
reviews.author: Jane Smith

reviews.text:
The restaurant is at the pool level of the Phoenician resort.
It serves all 3 meals.
It has a large dining room conveniently divided into section and a large patio where a handler is keeping a hawk sp that birds would not annoy the eaters.
The breakfast buffet is very extensive including a station where a chef prepares eggs to order. A full buffet breakfast cost $38.
The lunch and dinner menu offer tasty fares and specialty coffees (see photos).
Most dishes are $21-33.
Some photos show the 2 kids meals that we ordered.
Pleasant, relax setting.
The setting for dinner is relaxed elegance with dim lights. Service is very attentive.
My favourite was the whole brenzini fish (for 2) which arrives debunked to the table (see pgotos) all other dishes were great as well.
reviews.author: Rupert A.

reviews.text: Solid food, not perfect though. Broccolini came out almost as charcoals… The Duck leg was a bit dry but good flavor. I don’t know who decided to put marshmallows in this dish, but they don’t belong there. Ribeyes steak tasted great!
reviews.author: Anton S.

reviews.text:
Tl; Dr. food is ok, service is trash.

We came to have breakfast on Christmas Eve. There were clearly just a few tables, maybe half of the tables were occupied. It took our server forever to come to ask us what we wanted to drink, with a sulky and grumpy face for god knows what reason. She smiled and talked nicely to her other customers though, which made me think that she just hated us, or discrimination. She never checked on us, not even once. No refill on the water or whatsoever. She just dropped the bill on our table and said have a good day, still, no mentioning or asking if we need anything else.

Not until we saw the bill did we finally got to know her name. Yeah, she didn’t even introduce herself to us. In fact, she only said two sentences during the whole time.

This kind of service is definitely not acceptable for a $38 buffet experience at a high end resort like this. Almost left a $0 tip for this terrible service.
reviews.author: Susan Ng

reviews.text: Prendre un repas du midi dans ce grand hôtel grandiose, c’est vivre un instant de grand resort. La vue donne sur les nombreuses piscines et il se peut qu’il y ait un congrès. Donc, c’est très vivant. Surtout avec la présence d’un fauconnier qui présente son magnifique oiseau. La terrasse extérieure est protégée du soleil mais il est possible de choisir le plein soleil. Je suppose que les couchers de soleil sont magnifiques. Le serveur était très gentil. Un peu déçue du sandwich avec un pain trop gonflé, ce qui alourdissait sa texture. Après le repas, promenez-vous pour prendre des photos du resort avec son cadre près de la montagne.
reviews.author: Genoveffa Fiorin

reviews.text: I had the monkey bread for an appetizer, I initially thought it would be too sweet, but it was perfect. Chicken sandwich was delicious and cocktails were so tasty! Overall glad I went and I'll definitely be back.
reviews.author: Julie Rocha

reviews.text: Food and service was great.
reviews.author: Red Rock Windows & Doors

reviews.text: Came on a random weekday with a party of 4.  The food was fantastic. The menu selections were unique, and the portions were good.  I think the pricing is fair for the quality and ambience.  It's not as expensive as a high end steakhouse, and it's not as cheap as the Cheesecake factory.  It's somewhere in between.  I'd highly recommend their marinated hangar steak!  Their menu is seasonal, so I'll be back for sure for their winter options
reviews.author: Johnny 34

reviews.text: When I came here it was in March and during spring training, the venue is nice as it’s inside The Phoenician. The food & presentation was good but as others commented, a bit overpriced which is expected being at a resort. Unfortunately, it must’ve been busy season because it took forever for our food to arrive.
reviews.author: SFMasterP

reviews.text:
Excellent breakfast, we even came back for the same dishes, the second day in a row.

A really cool feature, which was ultra unique. They had the hawk man which had a pet hawk that was trained to keep the pesky birds away from bothering the patrons during breakfast. He would come to your table and show you the bird and tell you cool facts about it.

In regard to the breakfast, pancakes were unlike anything I’ve eaten before perfectly cooked and a delicate, but crunchy exterior and fluffy interior. They served it with real maple syrup, which was very tasty.

The ham and cheese omelette was absolutely divine. It was more of a French inspired omelette that was thin and fluffy like a pillow.

The fresh fruit was fantastic and ripe every piece was outstanding.

The cappuccinos were great and the service was fantastic.
reviews.author: Russ Oja

reviews.text:
Chef Danielle and team are doing a phenomenal job! Had lunch twice and dinner once during our stay. Every dish we had was delicious! Shelley, Jordan and Elba did a great job taking care of us. As did Ahmet the manager. Beautiful atmosphere. Perfect private dining room for a party!
The hostesses Julia and from Albania were amazing!
We will be back. Thank you!!
reviews.author: Heiner Zacher

reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician resort and Mowry& Cotton was excellent, the food was phenomenal, and the service was exceptional. We had breakfast every morning, and dinner once and it was a great experience from beginning to end, each time. I am posting the dinner, and the breakfast at the same time.
reviews.author: Debi LaStarza

reviews.text:
My family dined here due to having some vegan options but the food was great all around. I was able to order vegan eggs and sausage on panini bread, which was perfectly paired with their spiced ketchup. My family tried a few of the regular menu items but the bacon jam really stood out.
Shout out to our server, Jonathan. He was extremely accommodating and provided wonderful service.
reviews.author: Januari Stampfl

reviews.text: Great Service, Good View and Delicious food 💯👍
reviews.author: Yulianto Sutarko

reviews.text:
The food is okay—not bad but definitely not worth the price. I had breakfast and lunch here. The parfait was pretty disappointing—not enough fruit and the yogurt was tasteless. A side of three eggs costing $20 is wild. The lunch was better—I got the Turkey Cuban which was tasty but the side of chips were stale and flavorless.

Staff were all very friendly and the restaurant has tons of indoor and outdoor seating. Beware of the birds though if you’re sitting outdoors—they are ruthless!

Worth checking out considering it’s the only restaurant in the hotel, but the food is mediocre/very overpriced.
reviews.author: Tim Busekrus

reviews.text: Very underwhelming food. Took forever to get dried out meal. Very average service at a high price. Surprised such a nice resort had such an ok experience.
reviews.author: Zachary Hilton

reviews.text: Service very slow! Food mediocre.
reviews.author: Tom Beck

reviews.text: Food was just ok and service was mid at best. My water glass was empty 3/4 of the meal (not a good look in the AZ summer), monkey bread was worse than any home-made recipe, avocado toast was unremarkable with fancy colored but tasteless lettuce. It was $10 or $12 for two eggs and I ordered cooked over-medium but they served over easy (runny whites - bleah).   Tea, Avocado Toast, 2 eggs - over $40 and now I have to actually go somewhere else to get some real food.
reviews.author: David Pinkus

reviews.text: Everything was amazing! The food was impeccable and service top notch. The pool being nearby with little kids playing was the only small downside.
reviews.author: Adam Gibson

reviews.text: Best meal and experience I've had in a long time!
reviews.author: Shannon Fitzgerald

reviews.text: Our service and everything we ordered was absolutely amazing! Hector was our server and he went above and beyond the first time we ate there. Everything was so good we decided to go back for dinner the next night.
reviews.author: Ryanna McMillen

reviews.text: Amazing, got 2 egg meal, Sooooo good. Service was top tier and very respectful. Super fast and was hot. Outside was nice in the sun, someone had some sort of bird, I'm not sure, to scare away the little birds from eating your food. Table and chairs were super clean and beautiful! Prices are expensive as expected but we'll worth it!
reviews.author: Jace Williams

reviews.text: Nice but I wouldn't go there during the Porch Party Brunch one Sunday a month. Too crowded and a DJ. Love their salmon tartine and salad, the one with pomegranate and asparagus etc.
reviews.author: Nancy Mowry

reviews.text: Food was good but salty; desert was great. Server was fine but slooooow.  Dinner and desert took 3 hrs.
reviews.author: Renee Scavone

reviews.text: Worst service. food and staff attention. If there was a no star or minus star rating Mowry and Cotton have it. Waited 50 minutes for a drink. Dining room was less than 30% capacity for our 6:30PM reservation. Menu is limited and unimaginative. Food came out less than warm with obvious signs of sitting awhile. The meal was inedible. The staff did actually acknowledge the situation and did not charge for the entree because of the poor food quality and delivery. I did go elsewhere after because I was hungry. There are so many better places to go in Scottsdale. Avoid this place. If you are staying there, good luck. The high ratings for this place were not apparent on my visit.
reviews.author: Mike Mc

reviews.text: Everything about the restaurant/hotel is wonderful.  Service and atmosphere is great. I did not appreciate the food choices, nor the extensive use of add ons to the food. Nothing was simple, too many sauces and exotic flavorings. Not my style.  My lamb dish was a lot of creamy stuck-together pasta with a bit of shredded lamb. The other members of my party did enjoy their food, so perhaps it was just me.
reviews.author: Brian Leve

reviews.text: I had a pleasant breakfast. The food was adequate, and the portion sizes were particularly noteworthy. Two individuals could easily share an order of the pancakes. Each order included three substantial pancakes, which may be a compensating factor considering the slightly elevated cost of the pancakes. It was also intriguing to observe a hired hawk employed to deter birds from the patio area.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: Delicious food and very helpful staff!
reviews.author: Zeph Gillen

reviews.text: A wonderful Christmas dinner. A spectacular menu was setup for Christmas Dinner. The food was delicately crafted with a massive punch of flavor. The chefs got to have fun with the menu and it showed.
reviews.author: jonathan goddard

reviews.text: The food is good/average and I liked it but when we were there it was very busy and it took a long time to be sat and to get our food.
reviews.author: Ava B

reviews.text: Always a good time here. Good food and great views. One of my favorite places!
reviews.author: Kelli Calkins

reviews.text: Fine views. Fresh food. Friendly service. Pricey but expected.
reviews.author: Roman Bediner

reviews.text: Food and service was great! Kids also enjoyed their menu and meals (fun twist on chicken & waffles). Waitress was very knowledgeable on the menu and created a pleasant experience.
reviews.author: Robert Childs

reviews.text: Only had drinks, but the service was good and drinks as expected.
reviews.author: Warren

reviews.text: We were disappointed that the brunch was not available at 11:05 on a Friday. Ended up staying and having lunch. Food and service were as expected at a hotel restaurant.
reviews.author: Danny Ahrens

reviews.text: Service was subpar even though the restaurant was almost empty. Courses delivered too quickly and sides missing. Assistant manager was passive aggressive when we shared our disappointment and frustration with the bad dining experience. Would not recommend. J&G Steakhouse is a much better experience.
reviews.author: Claudia Mendès

reviews.text: Great food and Menu
reviews.author: Marc McIver

reviews.text:
I recently revisited Mowry & Cotton after having a great experience there for brunch a few years ago. Unfortunately, this time around, it was a disappointing visit that didn’t live up to my prior expectations.

The most noticeable difference was in the food quality, which seemed to have dropped significantly while the prices have surged. For three people, we ordered three drinks, three mains, and one appetizer, and the bill came out to a steep $200. For the price, we expected much more in terms of both flavor and presentation.

For the appetizer, we tried the tomato flatbread, which was forgettable and lacked any real punch. As for the mains, we had the tacos, croque madame, and ahi tuna bowl. The barbacoa in the tacos was the only highlight—tender and flavorful—but the rest of the dish, like the other mains, felt bland and uninspired.

The service didn’t redeem the experience either. Our server was distant and somewhat curt, making the overall atmosphere less enjoyable. While not outright rude, their standoffishness added to the sense that the restaurant has lost the charm it once had.

In the end, Mowry & Cotton felt like an overpriced and underwhelming dining experience. With a bill that high, I was hoping for something memorable, but instead, it felt like a letdown. I give it a 4/10 and probably won’t be returning anytime soon.
reviews.author: Maanav Setlur

reviews.text:
I have had better experience here before. This time around, I had breakfast on Tuesday and Wednesday morning and came away displeased.

Aside from nuances and subtlety of what is expected in a 5-star hotel restaurant, they also came up short on the basics.

On Tuesday, I told the team upfront that we only had an hour, and reminded them a few times after. We tried to order as quickly as we could with a large party (of 11 or so), but the breakfast didnt arrive until it was almost time to leave. It was a business dinner and our clients were going into a meeting right after. They had to run with their breakfast, which I am sure they could not consume as they were back to back. The time between ordering and getting our food out was very long and you could feel it.

Next day, it was just the three of us, and this time also I mentioned to the staff a few times that we only had an hour. Luckily the food arrived before it was time to leave, but again, between ordering and food being served, you could sense that it was an extraordinary period of time. Something you could just sense when food arrives late at a restaurant, I am sure we all know what that feels like.

Both days, the restaurant was empty so it’s not that the team was getting pulled into multiple tables. However, there was a conference and several events on the hotel property so am not sure if that was causing the delays.

Think it could have been better handled though.
reviews.author: Vaibhav Lohiya

reviews.text:
I recently had Sunday lunch at Mowry and Cotton at The Phoenician, and while the resort itself is beautiful, the dining experience was just okay. I ordered the salmon salad, but it was smaller than expected and pretty bland. The salmon was cold, lacked seasoning, and the portion size was underwhelming.

The highlight of the meal was the wild mushroom flatbread and potato chips, which were both delicious. However, when I ordered an iced latte, the server brought me a cappuccino instead. It wasn’t a big deal, and I didn’t complain, but given the price point, I expected better attention to detail and service.

Overall, while the setting was lovely, we were disappointed with the lunch, especially the salad. For a restaurant in such a renowned resort, I was hoping for a more memorable meal.
reviews.author: Adri M

reviews.text: The food was great and so was the service. The breakfast had quite a bit of variety and the French toast was very large. The dinner sides are large enough to share for 2 people and the Salmon was great! I would not recommend the chocolate cake.
reviews.author: kait Nichole

reviews.text: Was very impressed with the food and their three course special was very reasonable. If you go, be sure to have their buttermilk buns. They were soft and accompanied by a number of delectable spreads.
reviews.author: Adam Friedmann

reviews.text:
Dined here twice for breakfast since we had free breakfast (up to $80) as our perk, just had to be here before 11am. Both times, we (party of 3) were seated right away.

Food was delicious—downside is that the menu doesn’t change, so it was the exact same menu as the day before. HIGHLY RECOMMEND the Breakfast B.L.T., Avocado Toast and Huevos Rancheros! The Smoked Salmon & Bagel was great too. All delicious and tasty, and the portions are generous.

During our first visit, our lady server wasn’t the friendliest which left a bit of a sour experience. On our second visit, the next day, we got Christine who was beyond AMAZING!! Super friendly and attentive—Christine even went out of her way to get us Pina Coladas by the pool since the restaurant bar didn’t make them—truly grateful for her kind gesture. I would definitely request for her!
reviews.author: Vy H.

reviews.text:
What a great experience we had here because of Christine!!! She was so welcoming, accommodating and absolutely awesome! Little to no wait with warm greetings from hostess and staff.

The breakfast here is absolutely yummy. Breakfast food was well seasoned; the only complaint was that their menu does not change, we had the same menu options back to back. It would be nice to gave daily specials that varies from the staples.
reviews.author: linda hoang

reviews.text: Phenomenal food!! Devon ensured everything went smoothly and was extremely accommodating!
reviews.author: Matthew Wright

reviews.text:
Though it's definitely important to double check the bills due to there being multiple occurrences of the check being wrong and having to be corrected, the restaurant is nice--especially if you get a discount while staying at the resort.

The dinner menu is decent, but I person think that Mowry and Cotton shines best when it comes to it's breakfast menu. Almost every item has a delightful spin to it. The pancakes are huge, the French roast rises 5 inches off the plate, and the eggs Benedict has potato instead of bread. Moreover, the best dish has to be the Huevo Rancheros. You may be wondering how did Mowry Cotton innovate this dish, and they innovated the dish by using blue tortillas. The tortillas doesn't make the taste any different, but it has such a pleasing aesthetic!

Definitely a must go for breakfast!
reviews.author: A. J. L

reviews.text: We stayed at The Phoenician for the weekend of my wife's birthday and had dinner here. The service from when initially got in and throughout the dinner was great! The food was phenomenal. The food was savory and full of flavor with adequately sized portions. We got a filet mignon, coconut soup, a chicken meal that i was surprised by how much food I got, among other things. The staff was very helpful in holding a cake for my wife and even cutting and serving it to us. This restaurant is a great choice for dinner that I would recommend to anyone. I would suggest trying the carrots, they are 👌.
reviews.author: Gustavo Audelo

reviews.text: The crispy potatoes weren't crispy because they drowned it in sauces but other than that it was an excellent meal.
reviews.author: Anceli

reviews.text: Everything was so fresh and the staff is so wonderfully accommodating for a gluten free order. Al is a fantastic waiter.
reviews.author: Isabel Howard

reviews.text:
Just discovered this restaurant through Restaurant Week (May 2024) - GREAT DISCOVERY!

To start with, I had the Parsnip Coconut Soup: they brought the bowl with a little hill of orzo on the side, the thin strips of carrots and the green curry oil lying at the bottom and then they poured the soup on top if it - I was a bit iffy about the lemongrass pickled carrots but it was not pungent at all and it really combined really well with the velouté of the soup and the slight crunchiness of the toasted orzo - Deliciously light.

I also tasted the Veal and Black Garlic Meatballs - very fresh, with great tomato jam on top sprinkled with a couple of arugula leaves and two triangles of toasted bread. But I'd recommend the soup instead for its originality.

For seconds, I took the Charred Hanger Steak - a marvel: the plate was so nicely constructed with a brushed layer of sunflower pesto sauce, a nice portion of steak in the middle, covered with enoki mushrooms and a couple of slightly pickled blueberry on each side... Beautifully presented (but sadly I dived in before I could take a picture) and absolutely delicious! Make sure to try it out.

I also tasted the Lamb Pappardelle with cipollini onions and rosemary chimichurri - the pasta and the lamb was really well cooked and melting in the mouth.

And for dessert, the Lemon Tart was just the right amount of tang with a vanilla meringue, a few pomegranate seeds, manuka honey and two little clouds of dry milk foam... perfect! Especially when combined with the other great option: the Chocolate Cake - a dark chocolate mousse, raspberry, and smoked caramelia crème. The best way to end to end the meal.

For parking: if you plan to use self-parking, note that the covered parking building is a bit before the main area on your right. Follow the sign to the Main Lobby (which is +/- in the middle of the parking structure) to park as close to the escalators/elevators so you don't need to walk too much (I made the mistake of parking just as soon as I entered the parking, and I had to walk on heels for 2 minutes).
reviews.author: Katia Hennart

reviews.text: Hector our waiter was so attentive, knowledgeable and kind!  He steered me toward the hanger steak which was one of the best meals of our week at the Phoenician!   Thank you!
reviews.author: H S

reviews.text: The food, atmosphere and service was amazing. Cassie was great. The Iberico pork was some of the best meat I have eaten in a while.
reviews.author: Ruben Ramirez

reviews.text:
There is a lot of seatting outside with plenty of shade. Had the tacos for lunch, which were pretty good. The group I was with had the crispy chicken, and they really enjoyed that.

Service was great and brought us refills to go when the meal was done.
reviews.author: Nick Villanti

reviews.text: Both the avocado toast and fries were fantastic. The service was quick and friendly. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Chipmunk Nation

reviews.text: So, I have not actually graced the doors of this establishment, a friend of mine had to pick up some extra shifts through a temp agency she uses fairly often, because her regular job cut her hours down to part-time. I was merely her taxi service for the day. When I picked her up when her shift was over she gave me a large box full of the brunch leftovers, all I say is the food was absolutely delicioso, our conversation on the ride home was about the usual stuff, the job she did the atmosphere I am certain you are getting the picture. This place is very upscale, quite exquisite if you will, this is a 4 or star establishment for sure, i gave a 4 star rating, only because nobody is perfect.
reviews.author: Scooter

reviews.text: Very clean. Nice ambience. Wide variety of menu selections. Competent servers
reviews.author: Clare Bee

reviews.text:
Outside seating is beautiful
I had dinner ( lamb neck ) was cold
Overall o would come back for the beautiful seating
Breakfast yummy items like French toast
reviews.author: Leena Hafiz

reviews.text: Awoke this morning at the world renown Phoenician Resort and let me tell you there is no doubt this Oasis lives up to its excellent reputation. And the food here is only eclipsed by the service, and ambiance they create. Yes the view and resort are beautiful but let's talk about Pancakes! Wow the buttermilk banana pancakes are simply delicious! Fluffy, filling and flavorful. Of course I had coffee, which I am a coffee snob and this coffee was blended beautifully and the cup size was perfect to enjoy slowly. Also because coconut oatmeal intrigued me I had a small cup and I have found a new favorite! All in all a fantastic morning breakfast and Angelica my server made me feel like I was talking to family while visiting their home. I'll be back in the morning for breakfast again! LOL
reviews.author: Mark GRVConsulting Grado

reviews.text: The tuna bowl is outstanding and the staff in the bar is very conversational. Nice atmosphere.
reviews.author: Tom Carse

reviews.text: This was my fave place to eat at the resort and in the Scottsdale area while we were staying here. Not only is the food amazing, but the ambience and service is great too. Shoutout to our server Adam, he made us feel so welcome! I got the sea scallops and while pricey ($40 but I’m Canadian so it’s $53 CAD) , I cannot stop thinking about them! Absolutely delicious as was everything else we had. We also came here for brunch a couple times and again, great food and service. Highly recommend the eggs Benedict and shrimp and grits! Also there is a falconer who is around at breakfast /brunch with his falcon Blaze and it was so nice to chat with him!! I’d come back to this resort just for this restaurant!!
reviews.author: Ashley Howard

reviews.text: My grandson was sick all night.  When I called to ask if anyone else reported food poisoning I was informed NO with a laugh..What  was I thinking? A that a place like their's would never allow such a thing?  No vegetarian dishes other than salad. The service was AWESOME!! That is what makes this a hard review to write! We work hard and wanted to treat our family.  NEVER going back!!!!
reviews.author: Mari Roberts

reviews.text: Great pre-holiday breakfast in a lovely atmosphere.  Check out the falconer on the patio.
reviews.author: Michael Williams

reviews.text:
We dined here for breakfast while staying at The Phoenician and had a wonderful experience.

We were greeted and seated right away. We opted for a table on the patio. They were happy to turn the heater by our table on for us. All of the staff we interacted with was great, very friendly.

The menu is not very large, but there are some great choices.

At our table we tried both the Arizona Sun and Green Nectar juices, both were very good. They do not offer fresh-squeezed orange juice. We also got a hot chocolate, which was very creamy and delicious.

We ordered the Huevos Rancheros (signature dish) and it was amazing, great flavor.

We also ordered the Mowry’s Breakfast BLT, with turkey bacon instead of pork. This was one of the best breakfast sandwiches I’ve had in a while, the aioli they use makes this sandwich stand out. The potatoes were mediocre, I ended up not eating them.

We also got pancakes which were very light and fluffy, but had a nice crisp exterior.

The patio overlooks the pool area. While on the patio, there were a lot of birds. They had someone walking around with a hawk to keep them at bay so we did not have any issue with them approaching our table while we ate.
reviews.author: Nicole Mount

reviews.text: 牛排、沙拉，都非常好吃，服務也很棒。
reviews.author: C X

reviews.text:
This is my favorite place in the entire Phoenix area! I’ve been coming here for many years , especially for birthdays or celebrations, as it has something special! It never disappoints. Tonight, our server was Al Glover, he was very great at making us feel special! He gave us enough time to look at the menu and explained the questions we had about the food. He is a friendly guy and gave us the attention every guest wants without rushing us. Back to the food now! The food came pretty quick , we didn’t have to wait very long , we spent in total about 1.5 hours, that included out time to relax and enjoy the atmosphere. We got two cocktails, Bourbon & Boujee- the best, and 5 diamond manhattan, we ordered an appetizer Veal & Black garlic meatballs ( you won’t regret getting them - super good), and then the fish of the day ( the portion is pretty small) and a side of Crispy potatoes and then also the Mowry’s Big Burger ( cooked medium well done plus if I remember right ). I have to say that it was the best burger I ate in a restaurant.
I can’t wait to go back , definitely don’t miss this place , you’ll feel like on vacation if you are local. And if you visit from out of town, check it out for a wonderful Arizona experience.
Parking is free in the self parking garage , just ask at the restaurant for validation , to avoid the $10 fee
reviews.author: Diana Anghelus

reviews.text: Everything was excellent! We sat outside overlooking the gorgeous pool area. The umbrellas offered perfect shade. We ordered breakfast & it was excellent! Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jessie B

reviews.text: Amazing place
reviews.author: Beta Apps

reviews.text:
Would it kill the host to actually be at the host stand? I waited over 10 minutes to be seated in a restaurant with 3 tables and when he did show up his attitude was so lacklustre. Management, This is a luxury resort, please hire people that add to that fabric.

Nice view though
reviews.author: JSB CUISINE

reviews.text: Great atmosphere
reviews.author: Lesya Kovalenko

reviews.text: One of the best meals I’ve ever had - and I’ve been everywhere.
reviews.author: Bobby James

reviews.text: Excellent service. Amazing food. Incredible ambiance. Best brunch in Scottsdale area!
reviews.author: Erica Rogers

reviews.text: It's a beautiful place to eat lunch. We got there at  breakfast and the menu was all healthy options and names of items I never heard of.
reviews.author: Erie

reviews.text: Dinner is menu is very short and very expensive. Lunch and breakfast is good 😊
reviews.author: rajeev singh

reviews.text: Food was good, some minor issues nothing to complain about. Service was excellent and atmosphere was good.
reviews.author: Yvette Marie

reviews.text: We were in town visiting from Charlotte celebrating our anniversary, and we scheduled our celebration dinner here. They far exceeded our expectation. We are fans of the TV show the Bull, and there is an episode om season two on how to make visiting a restaurant memorable. Well, they took one right out of that show. They wished us Happy Anniversary, treated us exceptionally well, made us feel special, right down to dessert! Thank you for giving us a great experience and dinner!
reviews.author: Jennifer Miller

reviews.text:
Not sure why this place has so many negative reviews. First thing you need to find the parking, rather then driving all the way upto main entrance, park in the underground parking its $10 for 4 hours, but restaurants validates the parking.
Service here is great, staff is super polite and very considerate to your needs. Food here was decent, had shakshuka and chicken sandwich. Broiche bread for the sandwich was super soft and shakshuka was very flavorful.
reviews.author: yeti Y (yeti)

reviews.text: This place was beautiful right at the base of camel back mountain in the Phoenician resort. Adam or server was wonderful and extremely nice and funny, definitely a welcome change. We started with the mushroom flatbread and the avacado Cesar salad . Then had the hanger steak with roasted Brussel sprouts and crispy potatos. All of it was delicious. This place is definitely in the top 20 of my favorites.  If you're ever in Scottsdale, check it out. Thanks to the staff and servers for making a truly enjoyable evening.
reviews.author: erich gregg

reviews.text: We came in on Friday night with our extremely overtired 2 year old. The manager greeted us with a stuffed hawk which was the cutest gesture this Mama has ever seen at a restaurant. The food and service were superb. A colleague met us for dinner and the waiter was very respectful of our time. After my son had a meltdown and got swept away upstairs to go to sleep, we spent a lot of time catching up. Adam kept and eye on our drinks and only came over to ask if we need a refill. When it was time for the check, we had to ask for it which was actually awesome. We weren’t rushed out at all. I had a lovely experience and look forward to returning when we come back. (We also had breakfast there every morning and that was also fantastic)
reviews.author: Ashley Palski

reviews.text: We sat up at the bar to eat breakfast and had such a great experience. The bartender Raul was fantastic. He gave outstanding service. He certainly is an amazing mixologist and will certainly go back just to see him!
reviews.author: Bryan Curtis

reviews.text: Great food and service. Aggressive birds so they have someone with a hawk walking around outside, which is quite cool. Don't leave the table without covering up food and drink with a napkin, or the birds come in.
reviews.author: David Lindland

reviews.text: Best of the best staff and chefs very friendly and would definitely recommend to live eat or work .
reviews.author: Robert Rojas

reviews.text:
This place is absolutely amazing. Very friendly and attentive service. Big thank you to Lexi and Tom for making our stay so pleasant.

Had great conversations with Brad and Blaze! Who were making sure that birds don’t bother us while eating.

All in all 5stars!
We will definitely come back.

Thank you so much!
reviews.author: Madlyn Strobel

reviews.text:
Stayed at the resort for 3 nights, had breakfast here every morning. Fantastic food and comfortable sitting outside even though its 100+ F.
Tom the host is incredible welcoming and really cares. Lexi out waitress went above and beyond everyday to make sure we’re covered. Fantastic service we’ve throughout.
Will definitely come back
reviews.author: Niklas Strobel

reviews.text: This place is cute. But the food leaves a lot to be desired. And is very over priced. Even for resort style dinning. What they lacked in food taste the service made up for. Everyone was very very kind.
reviews.author: Liah Collier

reviews.text: We took the cocktail mixology class with Jordan and omg! He is fantastic! He explained so well and kept us engaged. He asked us questions about our preferences and explained all the liquors. I 100% recommend coming when he’s here and taking the class. He was just so personable, funny, and tentative! Jonathan was serving the tables and he was awesome as well. Two fantastic personalities making amazing drinks and letting us have such a great time! I want to come back just to come to the bar and hang with these two! Thanks Jordan and Jonathan!! 🩷
reviews.author: Lindsey Morini

reviews.text:
I'm not sure what all the hype is. The food we tasted is certainly not worth the prices one pays. They couldn't even get my burger cooked well done. The salad was bitter and sour. The kids spaghetti was room temperature and some cold spots. But the worst of all was the fries! They were greasy!! As if the oil was not hot enough. The ambiance was on point and service was phenomenal.
I would not recommend this place and I would not come back.
reviews.author: Ivan D

reviews.text: I went with my husband for our honeymoon/1 year anniversary in the beginning of June. We had Christian and Adam as our servers. They were so sweet and caring. They made us feel so comfortable. The food was phenomenal and so was the atmosphere. Adam became our new friend while we were there and even recommended that we go visit Scorpion Gulch. It was amazing. All in all, the Mowry & Cotton had great food, service, and friends there. Definitely worth it.
reviews.author: Michelle Csorba

reviews.text: The bartender Jordan is the best! He made me the most special and delicious drink for my birthday!
reviews.author: Ashley

reviews.text: I came here with my family for Arizona Restaurant Week. It’s within the Phoenician so parking is a bit of a nightmare and I ended up paying $10 for parking which is ridiculous. To get to the restaurant you enter through the lobby, turn right, walk down a flight of stairs and then you’ve reached Mowry & Cotton. I ordered the steak which I loved. It was cooked medium as requested and the mushrooms that came with it were amazing. My sister and dad ordered the same dish and requested it medium as well but that’s not what either of them received. One was very well done and the other was medium rare; for a high end restaurant with expensive prices this was very disappointing.  Loved the rustic Americana ambience and the food presentation was lovely, however the execution of my family’s meals was subpar.
reviews.author: Alexis Baker

reviews.text: Great location, atmosphere, service,  and food.
reviews.author: Daniel B Grogul

reviews.text: The atmosphere was contemporary and inviting. Al was especially welcoming and very accommodating. His timing on checking in and spacing out drinks and food was perfect. Overall, it was a wonderful experience.
reviews.author: Kelly Raz

reviews.text: Really great place with relaxing atmosphere and outstanding food. I highly recommend the beef barbacoa tacos! We went there for lunch and it took a little while for them to seat us because they were understaffed. But overall, we had a great experience!
reviews.author: Wesley Ellis

reviews.text: Excellent lunch with plenty of #Glutenfree options.
reviews.author: Carin Whitaker

reviews.text: Excellent
reviews.author: F M

reviews.text: Very classy,  interesting, unique setting with wonderful, friendly staff, great dining choices, excellent bar.
reviews.author: Michael Gerrity

reviews.text: Barmanmakes an excellent paloma and a killer naked & famous! Food is great too!
reviews.author: Jean-Camille LOISEAU

reviews.text: Food was delicious. Staff was very nice. Atmosphere was nice. Very loud and was hard to talk with our party. Overall good food and drinks
reviews.author: vinnie gopel

reviews.text: Enjoyed the monkey bread, crispy chicken sandwich, and spiced chips.  Also had smoked old fashioned and a revolver.  Food was good, service was great, and cocktails were the best.
reviews.author: Richard Salonek

reviews.text: We visited Mowry & Cotton while staying at The Phoenician for lunch. The restaurant is located on the pool side of the resort with indoor and outdoor seating available. The sausage flatbread was incredible. Some of the best flatbread I’ve ever had. We also tried the guacamole, barbacoa beef tacos, and duck carnitas. We left quite stuffed. Would give them a try again for brunch if ever back in the area.
reviews.author: Julian Andrews

reviews.text:
2.5/5
The omelette was probably the worst omelette I’ve ever had. Overcooked with deli ham, room temperature, cold toast, nothing special. But the chips, cocktails, and tater tots were good and the environment was great!

The server was subpar; she was inattentive, rude, and acted annoyed that we were even there. She acted inconvenienced when someone had a question about the menu. When the food came out, the server mumbled out each order like a raffle. “Who had the chicken?”

I expected the quality of food and service to be much higher in a place like this. I don’t know who is running this dog and pony show, but they need to figure it out.
reviews.author: Justine LaVi

reviews.text:
We eat out for breakfast daily and are lucky to have Mowry & Cotton so close to home. Setting is fabulous. The BLT sandwich is a home run. Often shared with either yogurt or oatmeal one can’t go wrong. Big fans of their Fonté coffee too.
Kudos to Natalia as the host and Angelica as our favorite waiter. These two go above and beyond. They are the reason we keep coming back.
reviews.author: KennyS

reviews.text: Had Al as a server tonight and he was more than amazing! Everything was delicious, cocktails were fantastic, and he was incredibly knowledgeable about pretty much everything. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jenn Botero

reviews.text: The entire Phoenician staff has been great and the food (both breakfast and dinner) at Mowry & Cotton were fantastic but have to give a special shout out to Romeo. He went above and beyond making our simple dinner a memorable experience. Do not hesitate to request him if he's working, thanks again Romeo (and everyone!) at M&C
reviews.author: Greg Ferrara

reviews.text: I am staying at Phoenician for a medical conference and decided to go to Mowry & Cotton, thinking it would be a slightly upscale but standard restaurant. However, to my very pleasant surprise, it was anything but that! The wine list, even by the glass, was clearly well curated with excellent, interesting wines -- some hidden gems, in my opinon. The mixed greens, which I thought would be standard, was large, perfectly dressed (which is rare these days), and had a beautiful balance of roasted carrots, garbanzo greens, light sweet red onions and other ingredients. The wild mushroom flatbread also had a perfect balance of flavor, savory with a hint of sweetness to balance the umami of the mushrooms. Last but definitely not least, the service was OUTSTANDING -- Adam was so friendly and I felt very welcomed and relaxed as I sat outside on the patio, enjoying the beautiful evening. Exceptional experience, with my thanks to the staff and Adam for a wonderful evening! I will definitely be back with husband when we are back in AZ next time. Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Radhika Breaden

reviews.text:
Did not have a pleasant experience with the Phoenician. The food menu was extremely limited. My date did not find anything vegan on the menu except a small salad and bread.
I expect more of 5 star establishment.
reviews.author: A Cornelius

reviews.text: Dinner was great. Cant say the same fir breakfast service. However food was good
reviews.author: Hovo Sepuhyan

reviews.text: Supetb food and service, which is what one would expect of a restaurant located in a five star resort (The Phoenician). The Veal Meatballs with Black Garlic and the Mushroom Flatbread were so good, I went back a second night to enjoy them again.  Casual, but classy, atmosphere with attentive and knowledgeable service staff.  There's a good wine list and tasty entrées as well.  I highly recommend this restaurant.  Reservations  recommended.
reviews.author: John Mueller

reviews.text: Accommodating is an understatement! Best service, thank you, Tatiana!
reviews.author: Hank Watt

reviews.text:
Superb setting for a nice brunch! The indoor decor is nice and the outdoor patio is fantastic.
The breakfast was nice, huevos rancheros were very well made. The berries bowl could have been a bit more fresh. The service was great. As you would expect from a higher end hotel the prices here are very high, however you will enjoy the experience.
The highlight was a hawk they carry to keep all the birds off. 🥰
reviews.author: Rahul M

reviews.text: Overrated, was shocked at the almost 5 stars. Service was not good despite the restaurant being almost empty on a Monday morning- they forgot smoked salmon with the smoked salmon bagel, their cream cheese is literally philadelphia cream cheese in a package lol. Their “sun dried cherries” are craisins. The “coconut oats” tastes like plain oatmeal. Do not come here expecting a luxury breakfast. Charged us a 20 percent “cabana service charge,” we had no idea what that meant, and turned out it was an error.
reviews.author: Colby K

reviews.text: We ate here multiple times during our stay. The food was incredible. The breakfast was just as good as dinner. We highly recommend this restaurant. Ernesto was our server and he was wonderful!
reviews.author: Diana Deaibes

reviews.text: Fast food restaurants serve tater tots for breakfast. This place is a prototypical luxury restaurant in a luxury resort that thinks they are wild and unique while they can’t even do the basics on a high level.
reviews.author: Aaron Coleman

reviews.text: Had breakfast here during our stay at the Phoenician. Food was lovely, decided to eat on the patio rather than inside (it was hot but there were fans and misters so it want too bad, and was our decision). Food and service was great and there was a falconer on staff to scare away birds for attacking people's food. Honestly I was most entertained by that!
reviews.author: Callie Rose Stark

reviews.text: Lexi was awesome and her drinks perfection.
reviews.author: CJ Evans

reviews.text: “The perfect blend of rustic and high lux….we had a blast “
reviews.author: Bernard Brown

reviews.text: Came here for lunch on a Friday while waiting for our room at the Phoenician to be ready. We ordered one flatbread as an appetizer, a burger, a sandwich and two drinks. The food was good, but not mind-blowing, and rather expensive for what you get. I would describe the lunch fare as elevated pub food, which for $20-25/plate I'm not sure if it's worth it. I had food at other local restaurants for the same cost that blew this place out of the water.  Additionally the server was very clearly over-sat and checked in us very infrequently. She wasn't rude or anything like that but our lunch took well over an hour. We had cups of water when we first sat down and then didn't get them refilled until we were halfway through the entrees. It probably took 20 minutes between each stage: after ordering for our drinks to show up, then another 20 for the appetizer, and after the appetizer for the food to show up. Tl;Dr I probably wouldn't recommend this spot for lunch. Dinner might be a better experience but I think it's a bit overpriced and the service was underwhelming.
reviews.author: Mikaila King

reviews.text: Amazing!!!
reviews.author: JASONLEE NICHOLS

reviews.text: On vacation at the Phoenician and went to this restaurant as a back up because J&G was closed. So disappointed- food still hasn’t arrived after 1.5 hours. Is there any more to say???
reviews.author: Johnna Powell

reviews.text: Our server was Adam and he was honestly probably the best server we’ve experienced in years. Great energy, attentive, and gave great insight to the menu regarding some dietary concerns. We hope to be back soon!
reviews.author: Shelby Rowley

reviews.text: Had more than 1 meal here.   Each meal was delicious.  Great staff.   Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Barbara Knott

reviews.text: Love the great Phoenician Hotel and the Mowry and Cotton restaurant provides a great dining experience! Great cuisine, view, and service!
reviews.author: John Dugas

reviews.text: The steak was delicious!
reviews.author: C. Davis

reviews.text: Excellent place to eat breakfast by the pool. Food was good!
reviews.author: Lalit Chopra

reviews.text:
Went for breakfast with my husband.

Atmosphere is AMAZING. Very beautiful scenery, especially on a sunny but cool November morning. We waited about 20 minutes for a table (arriving around 9:45 am without a reservation). We were seated at a five or six-seat table, which I found strange. But I’m not at all complaining! Haha had a great view overlooking the lush green landscape and beautiful flowers.

Food … well my husband got the burrito, which was absolutely delicious! I got the breakfast BLT and the citrus was way too overpowering for me (who hates citrus but was trying to be adventurous) and my husband (who LOVES citrus).

Service was decent. Our server was super nice, but kind of slow.

Restaurant validates your parking as well, which was a huge plus!

Overall, 4/5 simply because I didn’t like my food and like most things in Scottsdale, it’s a bit overpriced. BUT! I would most definitely say we’ll come back!
reviews.author: Lizz Morse

reviews.text: I usually never rate restaurants but I was so upset and displeased with my service that I had to. If I could give it zero stars I would. I stayed at the Phoenician for 4 nights and overall had a great experience until the final morning when I attempted to have breakfast here. I was a party of one and decided to sit at the bar thinking I would get quicker service. I order my food promptly and get a drink. 40 minutes pass and no sign of my food. The waitress asks “oh have you gotten your food yet?” obviously there is no food in front of me but I answer politely and say no. The couple to my left has received their meals (ordered after me) She checks in with the cooks and says they sent out my meal apparently to another guest. They say they will put a rush on my food and have it out in under 10 minutes. They offer a drink, I decline as I am really just interested in having the meal I ordered 50 minutes ago. 15 minutes pass and still no sign of my food. The restaurant closes at 11 now and I must also leave to checkout. Each morning I was supposed to get free breakfast during my stay and I couldn’t even eat on my last day! They give their apologies and are “kind enough” to compt the mimosa I ordered. This truly left a sour taste in my mouth. They are clearly understaffed (on Friday mornings atleast) as there are crowds of guests waiting to be seated.
reviews.author: Elyceia Dortch

reviews.text: When we arrived at 4:57 for a 5:00 reservation the hostess told us that we’d have to wait three minutes to be seated for the restaurant to open. Once we were seated we found the server to be friendly but overall service was slow. The food was mediocre at best, heavily salted and unimpressive. The food, service and ambiance definitely don’t justify the steep prices.
reviews.author: Jenny Hoffman

reviews.text: This is a hotel restaurant. I don’t know if we missed that in the description or… but it’s just basic food. Nothing special. Nothing fancy. Not really a date night meal. Super over priced because it’s for hotel guests to lazy to leave. If you are a local like us this is not the place to eat.  We would not come back. Also the service was crazy slow and we only saw our server just a handful of times, he never came back for drink refills or alcohol orders after the first drink. We would have drank a lot more, could have added another 100$ in alcohol if they would have just came back. Didn’t bother taking pictures because it was nothing special.
reviews.author: dawn pratt

reviews.text: Had brunch with my family here while staying at the Phoenician and was very disappointed by the service provided by staff. The front staff was stand offish and waitress working on Sunday, 9/05/21 from 9-11am was inattentive and rude to my parents. She didn’t take our drink order, had a cold attitude when trying to get her attention to order drinks, didn’t bring utensils, didn’t follow up, she dropped my mask on the floor by accident, didn’t pick it up. She also didn’t appear to be rushed at all. She killed the vibe this morning with the cold attitude. Was not the service I expected especially for the Phoenician.
reviews.author: Sania

reviews.text: Absolutely sublime.
reviews.author: Yancee Hardy

reviews.text: This restaurant is so good that my husband and I ate lunch here and turned right back around and ate dinner on the same day. Everything we got was delicious. Flatbreads, sandwiches, buttermilk buns, all of it. Service was excellent as well. If you’re in the area or staying at The Phoenician, this place is a must try.
reviews.author: Christine

reviews.text: We had breakfasts, lunches at some dinners at Mowry & Cotton during our stay at The Phoenician.  While all the menus are very limited and make it hard to find variety over a 9 night stay, breakfasts and lunches were fairly good.  The restaurant does not know how to cook a burger and no matter what temperature you order, you will always get a bone dry well-done burger.  The manager (Sam) was very helpful in trying to resolve this, but ordering medium-rare and getting well-done four times in a row is pretty absurd.  Food quality is otherwise good, though highly overpriced.  However, dinners are another story - menu is extremely limited and incredibly overpriced.  For example, scallops cost $41 and you get exactly 4 of them on your plate.  Bucatini pasta with shrimp added costs $42 and you get 4 shrimp.  Service is also hit or miss and waters seem to disappear for long periods of time on a regular basis.
reviews.author: Boris Nemirov

reviews.text:
This place made our 35th anniversary dinner fabulous. Bri was our server and she was amazing!!!!!!
If you go there, ask for Bri
reviews.author: RUSSELL STROUP

reviews.text: I’ve always had great experiences at the Phoenician until I ate at Mowry and Cotton yesterday. I ordered the panzanella salad and it didn’t have any bread on it. The part that I got tasted good though. My aunt asked for no berries in her side of fruit and it came loaded with berries. We were not offered any drink refills, including our water. Very disappointing.
reviews.author: Amy Barberio

reviews.text:
Great service.

Quality for the price is a bit off but food was good.
reviews.author: Sammy DeStefano

reviews.text: They took forever to bring us our food and drinks. The food barely had any taste/seasoning and lacked flavor. I bought the salmon and was excited to see that it looked good, but after eating it, it lacked flavor.  It was also a small piece of salmon. Not worth the price or wait at all.
reviews.author: Sinai Urbieta

reviews.text: While staying at The Phoenician we had dinner at Mowry & Cotton and had a great experience. The atmosphere of the restaurant is awesome, and on a nice night dinning on the patio is a spectacular option. We decided to share a bunch of the different small plates and that was a great way to go. There are many tasty options on the menu, and no matter what you try you will not be disappointed!
reviews.author: Grant Holmes

reviews.text:
We read many raving reviews of Mowry & Cotton’s breakfast menu but were sad to see that 3 weeks before our trip, all the AM reservations for our 5 day stay were booked. We decided to walk up one morning during our stay and check to see if they could squeeze us in. Surprisingly, on a Saturday morning, the wait was only 25-30 minutes. We were pleased with this as we could go back to our room or anywhere nearby and wait since they texted us once our table was ready.

While the food is a little over priced (to be expected for resort restaurants) we really enjoyed our breakfast here! We had the Huevos Rancheros, Avocado Toast, and the Açaí Bowl. ALL delicious! A little smaller portions than The Phoenician Tavern but quality was A++!

Andrew was our waiter and he did excellent in providing us great service, informing us of his favorite dishes, and just being all around kind and enthusiastic!
reviews.author: Alissa

reviews.text: The food was okay.  The artichoke appetizer was excellent.
reviews.author: Vickie Ryan

reviews.text: Great experience
reviews.author: Tanay Pahare

reviews.text: Fantastic dinner! The food and service were both wonderful. We shared the spinach artichoke dip, panzanella salad, and smoked short rib. They were all great but the cold smoked and 16 hour sous-vided short rib stole the show. It’s was spectacular.
reviews.author: Jay D.

reviews.text: The service and food were amazing!
reviews.author: Karissa Baldonado

reviews.text: Expertly prepared dishes. Everyone was delicious and beautiful to look at. Menu changes regularly. Beautiful view as sun goes down over the desert. Extremely nice and helpful staff. Might be pricey for some budgets but a special treat for birthdays and anniversaries.
reviews.author: Joe Gruberman

reviews.text: As a guest of the hotel, we decided to stay on site to try this place out and it did not disappoint. The service, drinks, and food all exceeded expectations. The bread and potatoes as appetizers were fantastic, the burger was a list topper, and the drinks sealed the deal. Can’t wait to go back!
reviews.author: Scott Thompson

reviews.text: Bartender Raul is the best. Very knowledgeable and I highly recommend sitting at the bar for a couple drinks! Ask for the Mexican candy shot
reviews.author: Dale Ervin

reviews.text: Friendly and accommodating kitchen.  Fabulous view inside and out.  Comfortable for 1-2 and large groups. Servers and management exceptional and submit to daily health checks.  The abbreviated menu offers a great selection and reasonably priced.
reviews.author: Jeanne Reagan

reviews.text: I'm a local who frequents the spa at The Phoenician (it's amazing). We stopped in here for a light lunch and really enjoyed ourselves. The atmosphere and seating is very calm and comfortable. I love the different combinations of flavors in everything prepared for us. My friend had the squash soup which I wish I could've bought a gallon of, it was that good and I'm not a soup person. I forgot the name of my salad but it was amazing. Service was top notch. Cheers!
reviews.author: Dana Lynn

reviews.text: The food is spectacular. The chef knows FLAVOR.
reviews.author: Lauren L-a

reviews.text: The staff was excellent and very friendly, but the food was mediocre.
reviews.author: Michael Smith

reviews.text: Delicious food. Great service from Ernesto. Lovely place to eat
reviews.author: Susanne Dershaw

reviews.text: Mixed reviews.  I would love to eat there in person.  I can't place an order over the phone.  I have to physically be there?  I offer my credit card but this is not allowed.  I have to wait there while the food is being prepare and physically expose myself to more individuals?  This is not covid friendly.  The food is great but this seems wrong.
reviews.author: L P

reviews.text: Tried this during restaurant week.  Food and service were good.  Reasonable wine list but very over priced.
reviews.author: Rich Murphy

reviews.text: Excellent food and great service
reviews.author: Carlos Delatorre

reviews.text: My friends and I booked a reservation to celebrate my birthday for 6 people this past Sunday evening. Unfortunately we had a terrible experience. Our server was very kind, however he was not trained on simple menu questions regarding quantity and ingredients in food and drinks. Our reservation was for 6:30, and we didn't receive our drinks until 7:15. Food took another hour I would estimate. And we observed many other tables in the restaurant were in the same situation without food. There seemed to be a major breakdown in terms of staffing and it turned into an embarrassing birthday celebration. When our food finally came several items (including entree's for two of us) were completely forgotten. At that point due to the length of time we'd been there and overall frustration we asked them to cancel the missing food items, finished our food and left defeated. I suspect it had something to do with re-opening after being closed for a while; however at this price point I would expect the restaurant to be fully staffed and trained up before filling the restaurant with customers again. Overall it was a very disappointing experience.

Amazing Experience!!! Our server Art was very attentive, and explained basically every aspect of the menu for us. You can tell he definitely knows what he is doing, and enjoys his job! He made our experience one to never forget!! Seriously best service I have ever had! Oh, and don't even get me started on the food! He went out of his way to get me some gluten free bread (apparently it's served during breakfast). The plate with the buttered bread we ordered was decorated beautifully with butter, and I think blueberry jam. We also tried these sweet peppers (they look like jalepenos) with feta and some other flavors I can't quite pinpoint, but it was the most delicious treat ever!!! I will be craving it for forever (I don't think it is on the menu though, but I'm sure you could ask for it, idk). Their potato crisps were like fancy rounded french fries (almost like potato chips style) with so many amazing flavors, I would definitely order them again!The Ribeye steak was the absolute BEST steak I have ever had in my LIFE! It cut like butter, and had so many different flavors, I sat there just not wanting to stop eating it!! Also they have a champagne that is made specially for the restaurant, and I thoroughly enjoyed it, even though it wasn't super sweet like I usually go for. My fiance also had the donuts for dessert, which he ate even though he was full, because they were so delicious. They came with mini bottles of chocolate, strawberry sauce, and caramel sauce, which were all high quality. I would definitely come back to eat here again!! Best experience I have ever had at a restaurant, hands down!

reviews.text: Hosting a restaurant at a $400 million dollar resort implies a level of service and attention to detail that must be impeccable if you want the core clientele to take notice. Mowry & Cotton, which serves seasonally inspired American Cuisine, fails to impress on several levels. As this was a visit during Arizona Restaurant Week, I expected to be presented with the prix-fixe menu by the hostess but instead was given the standard menu. When I asked the server for the restaurant week menu, he retreated and then rummaged through some drawers until he could find them. This is restaurant week in a featured restaurant, and it makes me a little sad to think that instead of joining the celebration, Mowry & Cotton would rather hide away the prix-fixe menu and charge full price to unaware patrons. There were four of us dining together and we decided we would add-on the Buttermilk Buns served with citrus sea salt and duck fat fig butters. We had two orders, as suggested by our server, which was too much for the four of us as a starter add-on. The buns were hot, fresh and delicious, and the two different butter choices were pleasant and tasty. I did feel though that the dried corn sprinkled on the fig butter was odd and didn’t seem to add much of value. The First course I chose was an Heirloom Tomato Salad with beets, burrata, and a citrus vinaigrette. The salad was served haphazardly, appearing as a plain pile of arugula. It wasn’t until I dug into it, that I discovered the other ingredients. The heirloom tomatoes were very overly ripened and mushy, which was confirmed by one of my dining companions who had also, unfortunately, ordered the salad. If I had invited guests over for dinner at my home, I would never think of serving them tomatoes so far gone. Second course was Atlantic Halibut with bok choy, bell pepper, and green peri peri sauce. At first glance it presented beautifully, but then I notice the greasy fingerprints on the plate diminishing the effect. The halibut is tepid in temperature which is concerning. Was it left waiting to be served and cooled down, or did it never quite reach appropriate cooking temperature? It tastes fine, however, and is flaky and well seasoned. The peri peri sauce is a vibrant and tasty companion with the fish and the vegetables which are also quite good. For dessert I chose Lemon Meringue. Mowry & Cotton serves this as a lemon tart with the meringue as a garnish rather than a feature. The lemon tart was pleasant but the meringue was bone dry and reminiscent of stale childhood cereal. It was not something I would order again. After we paid the check and were heading out, we passed our server who was leaning against the bar watching television. He didn’t look up or acknowledge our departure though the restaurant was mostly empty. Overall, it was a dining experience that I might have expected to receive at a random low-end chain restaurant, but not at the Phoenician. It was a disappointing experience at Mowry & Cotton in service, presentation, and quality.

The meals are modern with a world twist. Brussels sprouts with kimchee (not even close to overpowering, so don't be afraid to order it) and bonito flakes was one of my favorites. The beet salad, was with Carolina bbq flavor, well seasoned, where again you get the flavors of the ingredients and nothing was lost in the spices. The lamb tacos were my favorites. Pulled lamb meat with harissa sauce, a pickled melody of red onion, cucumber, and red cabbage, with yougurt was spectacular. The meat was so tender. I wish could have that dish weekly. Overall this is a great restaurant and I would recommend it.

reviews.text:
Brunch update:
This is hands down the best brunch I've had in Arizona. First off, the staff is incredibly friendly and highly knowledgeable about each item on the menu. They make great recommendations based on your personal tastes and will follow up to make sure everything is as you expected. The brisket Benedict was OUT OF THIS WORLD, and that's coming from a true Benedict connoisseur. The pork plate was a wonderful variety of meat from a whole hog but the real star of this dish is the crumpets, they're truly delicious. The Brussel sprouts were cooked perfectly. The sorbet mimosas are the perfect way to cap the meal. I highly recommend the passion fruit!

Outside, they have a falconer who is very friendly and will show you his falcon and explain all the intricacies or taking care of such a majestic animal.

Overall, I would highly recommend Mowry and Cotton to anybody passing through Phoenix!
